items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: his arranger would sound like Lunceford's

ctx.x: And -- because Nat had a good band, and his arranger would sound like Lunceford's, see. And all

the good musicians, but his drummer was weak. And I had gone back to playing drums with Lloyd, see. And Lloyd had gotten another bass player. So his drummer didn't cut the mustard, as they say. He was the weakest guy in the band.
